title: Whitney's C¹ extension theorem on ℝⁿ (Simon Ch. 2, Theorem 1.6)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let A ⊆ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) be closed, and let f : ℝⁿ → ℝ and τ : ℝⁿ → (ℝⁿ)* = L(ℝⁿ, ℝ) be continuous on A. Assume that for every compact L ⊆ A and every δ > 0 there is ρ > 0 with |f(y) − f(x) − τ(x)(y − x)| ≤ δ|y − x| for all x ∈ L and y ∈ A with |x − y| < ρ. Then there is a C¹ function h : ℝⁿ → ℝ such that for every a ∈ A, h(a) = f(a) and h is Fréchet differentiable at a with derivative τ(a).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Eucl n)) (f : Eucl n → ℝ) (τ : Eucl n → (Eucl n →L[ℝ] ℝ)), IsClosed A → ContinuousOn f A → ContinuousOn τ A → (∀ L : Set (Eucl n), IsCompact L → L ⊆ A → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y < ρ → ‖f y - f x - τ x (y - x)‖ ≤ δ * ‖y - x‖) → ∃ h : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 h ∧ ∀ a ∈ A, h a = f a ∧ HasFDerivAt h (τ a) a
